title: Dead Boys Poem-traducido
lyrics_synced:
[00:00.00] By Nightwish sequenced by FioGenerated by NoteWorthy Composer
[00:00.00] Born from silence, silence full of it (Nacido del silencio, lleno de silencio)
[00:07.38] A perfect concert my best friend
[00:13.85] (Un concierto perfecto, mi mejor amigo)
[00:14.77] So much to live for, so much to die for
[00:21.69] (Tanto por vivir, tanto por morir)
[00:21.92] If only my heart had a home
[00:26.31] (Si solo mi corazón tuviera un hogar)
[00:29.54] Sing what you can't say
[00:32.54] (Canta lo que no puedes decir)
[00:33.00] Forget what you can't play
[00:36.23] (Olvida lo que no puedes interpretar)
[00:36.92] Hasten to drown into beautiful eyes
[00:42.92] (Presuroso en ahogarte en bellos ojos)
[00:44.31] Walk within poetry, this dying music
[00:51.00] (Camina entre la poesía, esta música moribunda)
[00:51.69] My loveletter to nobody
[00:56.31] (Mi carta de amor para nadie)
[00:59.08] Never sigh for better world
[01:05.08] (Nunca suspires por un mundo mejor)
[01:06.23] It's already composed, played and told
[01:12.69] (Ya está compuesto, interpretado y dicho)
[01:13.85] Every thought the music I write
[01:20.54] (Cada pensamiento, la musica que escribo)
[01:22.15] Everything a wish for the night
[01:27.23] (Todo es un deseo para la noche)
[01:28.62] Wrote for the eclipse, wrote for the virgin
[01:35.31] (Escribí para el eclipse, escribí para la virgen)
[01:36.00] Died for the beauty the one in the garden
[01:42.69] (Morí por la belleza, la que está en el jardín)
[01:43.38] Created a kingdom, reached for the wisdom
[01:50.08] (Creé un reino, alcanzado por la sabiduría)
[01:50.77] Failed in becoming a god
[01:54.69] (Fallé en convertirme en un dios)
[01:58.15] Never sigh for  better  world
[02:04.62] (Nunca suspires por un mundo mejor)
[02:05.31] It's already composed, played and told
[02:11.77] (Ya está compuesto, interpretado y escrito)
[02:12.92] Every thought the music I write
[02:19.85] (Cada pensamiento, la música que escribo)
[02:21.23] Everything a wish  for the night.
[02:26.31] (Todo es un deseo para la noche)
[02:27.23] Poema:
[02:27.92] "If you read this line, remember not the hand that wrote it
[02:32.31] (Si lees estas líneas, no recuerdes la mano que las escribió)
[02:32.54] Remember only the verse, songmaker's cry the one without tears
[02:36.69] (Recuerda sólo el verso, el llanto del creador de canciones, ese sin lágrimas)
[02:37.15] For I've given this its strenght, and it has become my only strenght.
[02:41.08] (Porque le he dado fuerzas, y se ha
[02:41.31] transformado en mi propia fuerza)
[02:41.54] Comforting home, mother's lap, chance for immortality
[02:45.69] (Hogar confortable, regazo de madre, oportunidad de inmortalidad)
[02:46.15] Where being wanted became a thrill I never knew
[02:49.62] (Donde el ser querido se transformó en una emoción que nunca conocí)
[02:50.08] The sweet piano writing down my life".
[02:52.85] (El dulce piano escribiendo mi vida)
[03:27.00] Teach me passion for I fear it's gone
[03:28.62] (Muéstrame la pasión que temo que la perdí)
[03:28.85] Show me love, hold the lorn
[03:30.46] (Muéstrame el amor, oculta la desesperanza)
[03:30.92] So much more I wanted to give to the ones who love me
[03:33.92] (Tanto más que quería darle a los que me aman)
[03:34.62] I'm sorry
[03:35.54] (Lo siento)
[03:35.77] Time will tell
[03:36.92] (this bitter farewell)
[03:37.85] (El tiempo dirá) (esta amarga despedida)
[03:38.31] I live no more to shame nor me nor you
[03:40.38] (No vivo más para no avergonzarte ni a ti ni a mi)
[03:41.54] And you... I wish I didn't feel for you anymore..."
[03:46.85] (Y tú...  Desearía no haber sentido más por tí)
[03:47.54] A lonely soul...
[03:49.15] (Un alma solitaria)
[03:50.08] An ocean soul...
[03:51.46] (Un alma de océano)
